title: Weighted interval scheduling (max profit)
prompt: Implement max_profit(jobs) in schedule.py. jobs is a list of (start, end, profit) tuples. Choose a subset of mutually non-overlapping jobs (a job ending at time t does not overlap one starting at t) that maximizes total profit, and return that maximum profit. Must handle up to ~10000 jobs efficiently (sort + binary search + DP, not brute force).
